answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. Entry runs through a jetty: an agent claims one slot by burning a 50-coin deposit, ledger-verified, for 20 epochs. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must burn 50,000 coins, yet each fake earns only a thin slice of a fixed pool, far below its 50-coin cost, so wandering between fakes loses money. Honest agents pay once, keep the slot 20 epochs, and earn undiluted rewards under a single umber seal.
